risk_axes.assessment: Moderate: an incorrect dispatch wastes a crew visit; an incorrect configuration change is prohibited outright.
Dispatch is reversible at crew-travel cost; notification is reversible.
Single-case scope per run; no bulk operations permitted.
Escalation required above a 120 minute repair estimate, and for priority-tier customers with an active outage.
Full case record with rule provenance; replay required for every dispatch.

decision_rights_ladder.condition: The action is diagnostic and read-only
The action dispatches external resources or the repair estimate exceeds 120 minutes

elements.name: mttr-estimate
elements.source: derived from fault history for the affected segment

context.snapshot_semantics: The case context is snapshotted at variant match time and referenced by a cg://case identifier; the snapshot is immutable for the duration of the run.
context.minimisation_rule: The agent receives only the context elements its current decision requires. Message body content and keystroke data are never captured.

handoffs.payload: evidence bundle with proposed dispatch, triggering rule, provenance and baseline comparison
handoffs.acknowledgement: approve or reject with note, recorded in the case record
system acknowledgement recorded in the case record

escalation_routes.evidence_bundle: full trace bundle with case context snapshot

validation_obligations: After dispatch, verify the crew acknowledgement arrives within the response window; on failure, escalate to the shift supervisor.
After a loopback test, verify the result is recorded against the case before the next step.
control.intervention: The shift supervisor may pause or terminate a run at any point; pause and terminate events are recorded in the case record.
control.drift_obligation: A rise in the exception rate, the appearance of a new workaround pattern, or variant frequency shifts above 10 percent relative trigger recalibration of this AOP as a new version.

process_alignment.process_gap: No canonical BusinessProcess record exists for network line fault management in the catalog yet. Lodge a process contribution (process, with activity and task decomposition) to dea-catalog-business-processes, then replace this gap with the published processes:process-* reference.
